= Solaran Alphabet =

The '''Solaran Alphabet''', also known as '''Sunline''', is the standard writing system for the [[Solaran]] language.

== History ==

The Sunline alphabet was commissioned by the [[Solaran Parliament]] in 1895 as part of a national literacy initiative. It was designed to be:
* Easier to learn than the Elder Tongue's abugida
* Compatible with modern printing technology
* Suitable for everyday communication
* Distinct from other world scripts

The development of Sunline was a response to the growing need for mass literacy during Solara's industrial expansion in the late 19th century. The alphabet was officially adopted in 1898 after three years of development and testing in schools across the nation. The Parliament's Education Committee played a crucial role in overseeing the project, ensuring that the new writing system would serve both educational and practical needs of the growing nation.

== Structure ==

The Sunline alphabet consists of '''26 letters''', derived from simplified and rotated strokes of the classical script. It is written left-to-right, with vowels and consonants written on the same line.

== Punctuation ==

The Sunline alphabet uses several punctuation marks:
* '''.''' - Full stop
* ''',''' - Comma
* '''?''' - Question mark
* '''!''' - Exclamation mark
* '''"''' - Quotation marks
* '''-''' - Hyphen
* ''':''' - Colon
* ''';''' - Semicolon

== Usage ==

The Sunline alphabet is used for:
* Everyday writing and communication
* Official government documents
* Education (primary and secondary)
* Newspapers and media
* Business and commerce
* Street signs and public information
